name: K562 ONT long-read RNA-seq, recovery of 6 known fusions and count of other calls (Dorney et al. 2026)
description: Per-caller number of known K562 fusions recovered and number of other (putative novel) calls, by library type and depth.

attributes.protocol: Calls annotated against the authors' list of previously reported K562 fusions (6); knownnumber counts distinct calls labelled known and novelnumber all other distinct calls (repository CellLineData/SGNex_DiscoveryNRecall.R).
limitations: Independent benchmark: the authors developed none of the six callers (Competing interests: none). Preprint, not peer reviewed.
Caller versions for CTAT-LR-Fusion and GFSeeker are not stated.
The known list (6 fusions) comes from the literature; fusions missing from it count as other calls, so the other-call count mixes real unlisted fusions and false calls.
No read-support filter is applied in the counting script; the run-level two-read filter stated in Methods may or may not apply here.
Counts only; no precision or recall printed. Single run per library and depth.

knownnumber is the number of distinct call records the authors' script labels known (grouped by gene pair, chromosomes and fusion type); the script does not deduplicate them to listed fusions, so it is an upper bound on the number of listed fusions recovered.
Only six known K562 fusions, so recovery is coarse.
CTAT-LR-Fusion has no K562 PCR-cDNA rows at 7.5 or 10 Gb, and no caller has K562 direct-RNA rows above 2.5 Gb or direct-cDNA rows above 5 Gb; the source does not say why.

name: Simulated long-read fusion detection, 400 fusions at three depths and three read identities (Dorney et al. 2026)
description: Per-caller false and true calls, precision, recall and F1 against simulated fusions, calls with at least two supporting reads.

attributes.protocol: A call is a true positive only if both partner genes (Ensembl IDs, correct chromosome for paralogues) match a simulated fusion; partial recalls count as false positives. Recall = TP / simulated fusions present (Spiked_Number); precision = TP / (TP + FP); F1 their harmonic mean. Calls need at least two supporting reads.
limitations: Independent benchmark: the authors developed none of the six callers (Competing interests: none). Preprint, not peer reviewed.
Caller versions for CTAT-LR-Fusion and GFSeeker are not stated.
Simulated reads with synthetic fusions, not tumour RNA; most simulated fusions are not cancer drivers.
At 1 Gb the denominator (Spiked_Number) is 187 to 208 rather than 400, and at 10 Gb and 85% identity it is 397; the source does not explain why. Some callers have no row at 1 Gb (no calls).
Results prose gives false-call counts (GFSeeker 632, FusionSeeker 519, JAFFAL 106, CTAT-LR-Fusion 38) that do not match any row of the table; the scenario or filter they refer to is not stated.
Single simulation per scenario; no interval estimates. The FDR and Sensitivity columns repeat 1 minus precision and recall and are not recorded.

attributes.endpoint: Precision, recall, F1 and true and false call counts of six long-read fusion callers on 400 simulated fusions at nine depth and read-identity scenarios
attributes.rationale: Proxy, not direct: an independent comparison of long-read callers with a complete truth set measures sensitivity and false calls, but the reads and fusions are simulated, not tumour RNA.
constraints: Inspect every linked evaluation's source locator before citing a result.
Do not combine this mapping's evaluations with any other protocol's results; truth sets, specimens, sequencing and caller versions differ between sources.
limitations: Independent benchmark: the authors developed none of the six callers (Competing interests: none). Preprint, not peer reviewed.
Caller versions for CTAT-LR-Fusion and GFSeeker are not stated.
Simulated reads with synthetic fusions, not tumour RNA; most simulated fusions are not cancer drivers.
At 1 Gb the denominator (Spiked_Number) is 187 to 208 rather than 400, and at 10 Gb and 85% identity it is 397; the source does not explain why. Some callers have no row at 1 Gb (no calls).
Results prose gives false-call counts (GFSeeker 632, FusionSeeker 519, JAFFAL 106, CTAT-LR-Fusion 38) that do not match any row of the table; the scenario or filter they refer to is not stated.
Single simulation per scenario; no interval estimates. The FDR and Sensitivity columns repeat 1 minus precision and recall and are not recorded.
